punchline: At Marburg the danger came from the supply chain, not from inside the laboratory.
thirty_sec: In 1967 people working with tissue from African green monkeys imported from Uganda fell ill with a new virus in Marburg, Frankfurt and Belgrade; the CDC counts 31 cases and seven deaths.
question: Which input to your work have you never questioned the source of?
key_contrast: Checking only your own steps versus questioning the source of your inputs too.
